Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class ChatService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.ChatService
public class ChatService extends Object
Shared buyer/seller private messaging. Messages and recipient notifications commit together.

  • Method Details

    • getInbox

      public List<ChatThread> getInbox(User actor) throws SQLException
      Returns the signed-in buyer's or seller's chat inbox.

      Accepted, completed, and returned deals that have no chat thread yet are first materialised as threads for the signed-in participant. Only threads the account participates in are returned, newest activity first.

      Parameters:
      actor - the signed-in buyer or seller
      Returns:
      the participant's chat threads
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the stored account is missing, inactive, or an admin
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • openForDeal

      public ChatThread openForDeal(User actor, String dealId) throws SQLException
      Opens or reuses the listing conversation between the buyer and seller of a deal.

      The deal is locked and the signed-in account must be its buyer or seller. The conversation is keyed by listing and participant pair, so it is reused across later proposals and deal state changes.

      Parameters:
      actor - the signed-in buyer or seller
      dealId - the deal whose participants and listing identify the conversation
      Returns:
      the existing or newly created thread
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an identifier is invalid, the account is not an active buyer or seller, the deal is missing, or the account is not a participant
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • openForListing

      public ChatThread openForListing(User buyer, String listingId) throws SQLException
      Opens or reuses a listing conversation for an active buyer before any deal exists.

      The listing must be visible in one of the live, reserved, sold, lent, or given states, and its seller must still be an active seller.

      Parameters:
      buyer - the signed-in buyer
      listingId - the listing to discuss
      Returns:
      the existing or newly created thread
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an identifier is invalid, the account is not an active buyer, or the listing or seller is unavailable
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • getConversation

      public ChatConversation getConversation(User actor, String threadId, String search) throws SQLException
      Returns a participant's conversation, optionally filtered by message text.

      The search term is matched as literal text and must be at most 4,000 characters. The result reports whether the counterpart account still allows sending, so a conversation with an unavailable counterpart is presented as read-only.

      Parameters:
      actor - the signed-in buyer or seller
      threadId - the conversation identifier
      search - optional literal text to filter messages, or null
      Returns:
      the thread, its matching messages in send order, and the send capability
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an identifier is invalid, the search term is too long, the account is not an active buyer or seller, or the thread is missing or not owned by the account
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails

    • sendMessage

      public ChatMessage sendMessage(User actor, String threadId, String text) throws SQLException
      Appends a text message from a conversation participant and notifies the recipient.

      The message body is stripped and must contain 1 to 4,000 characters. The account must be an active participant, and the counterpart must still exist as an active account of the opposite role; otherwise the conversation is read-only and the send is rejected. The message and the recipient's "New Chat Message" notification commit together.

      Parameters:
      actor - the signed-in sender
      threadId - the conversation identifier
      text - the message text
      Returns:
      the persisted message
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an identifier or the text is invalid, the account is not an active buyer or seller, the thread is not owned by the account, or the other account is unavailable
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • sendProposal

      public ChatMessage sendProposal(User actor, String threadId, String dealId) throws SQLException
      Shares the sender's current proposal or counteroffer as an immutable chat message.

      A buyer may share a Pending proposal and a seller may share a Countered counteroffer. The thread must match the deal's listing and participants. The message stores the deal id, row version, type, and terms with the appropriate message kind. Repeating the call for the same deal version returns the existing message without creating a duplicate notification.

      Parameters:
      actor - the signed-in buyer or seller
      threadId - the conversation identifier
      dealId - the proposal identifier
      Returns:
      the newly created or previously stored proposal message
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an identifier is invalid, the account is not an active buyer or seller, the deal or thread is unavailable, the participants do not match, or the sender has no shareable Pending or Countered proposal
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back
